offers_products.reason: Main offering is online degree programs taught by faculty; no goods or software sold.

offers_services.reason: University of Phoenix provides online higher education programs and instruction to students.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Working adult students choose and attend its degree programs.

sells_to_organizations.reason: 2,500+ employer alliances provide workforce upskilling and reskilling solutions for employers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Students pay tuition term after term across multi-year degree programs, with roughly 80,000 enrolled.

cyclical_demand.reason: Adult education for career advancement tends to hold up or rise in downturns; it is not easily postponed.

big_ticket.reason: Tuition is paid in recurring per-course or per-term installments, not one large purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Value is delivered by faculty teaching and staff support; instruction would stop without them.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual students; employer partners are secondary.

asset_heavy.reason: Online university relies on a technology platform and faculty, not plants, fleets or large property holdings.

notes: Students are the main buyers, though tuition is often funded by federal aid or employers.
